newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR OCTOBER 12-14.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR OCTOBER 12-14.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for period October 12-14:
Saturday, Oct 12:
English premier league - Blackburn v Arsenal, Derby v
Newcastle, Everton v West Ham, Leeds v Nottingham Forest,
Leicester v Chelsea, Manchester United v Liverpool, Tottenham v
Aston Villa, Wimbledon v Sheffield Wednesday.
Division one - Barnsley v Crystal Palace, Birmingham v
Bradford, Bolton v Oldham, Porstmouth v Charlton, Queens Park
Rangers v Manchester City, Reading v Grimsby, Sheffield United v
Tranmere, Swindon v Oxford, West Bromwich v Huddersfield.
Division two - Blackpool v Gillingham, Bournemouth v
Wycombe, Crewe v Brentford, Millwall v Chesterfield, Notts
County v Bristol Rovers, Peterborough v Bury, Rotherham v
Burnley, Shrewsbury v Luton, Stockport v Preston, Walsall v
Plymouth, Watford v Wrexham.
Division three - Brighton v Cambridge United, Cardiff v
Barnet, Colchester v Wigan, Exeter v Northampton, Fulham v
Doncaster, Hartlepool v Darlington, Leyton Orient v Hull,
Mansfield v Swansea, Rochdale v Carlisle, Scarborough v Chester,
Scunthorpe v Lincoln, Torquay v Hereford.
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Dunfermline, Celtic v
Motherwell, Dundee United v Kilmarnock, Hibernian v Rangers,
Raith v Hearts.
Division one - Clydebank v Airdrieonians, Falkirk v Dundee,
Partick v East Fife, St Johnstone v Greenock Morton, St Mirren v
Stirling.
Division two - Ayr v Livingston, Berwick v Stranraer, Clyde
v Stenhousemuir, Hamilton v Dumbarton, Queen of the South v
Brechin.
Division three - Alloa v Forfar, Arbroath v Queen's Park,
Cowdenbeath v East Stirling, Montrose v Inverness C. Thistle,
Ross County v Albion.
Sunday, Oct 13:
English premier league - Coventry v Southampton.
Division one - Port Vale v Stoke, Southend v Wolverhampton.
Monday, Oct 14:
English premier league - Sunderland v Middlesbrough.
